milestone1.title: 情境選句(章 1-4 — 開場 / 提議 / 同意反對)

questions.prompt: 你主持會議,開場最自然?
options: Thanks everyone for joining. Let's get started.
questions.explanationZh: Thanks everyone for joining 是會議主持標配;get started 比 begin 口語自然。

questions.prompt: 跨時區會議開場小聊,最安全?
options: Why are you up so early?
questions.explanationZh: 天氣最安全;避政治 / 宗教 / 個人收入 / 私生活。

questions.prompt: 從 small talk 切換進主題,合適的訊號?
options: Alright, shall we dive into the proposal?
questions.explanationZh: dive into 是切換訊號;Alright 軟過渡讓對方知道進主題了。

questions.prompt: 試探性提議,最不會被批駁?
options: What if we tried a different approach?
questions.explanationZh: What if 是疑問句,不會被批駁;會議高頻試探技巧。

questions.prompt: 想委婉表達「我比較傾向 A 不是 B」?
options: A is right, B is wrong.
I'd lean toward A rather than B.
questions.explanationZh: lean toward = 比較傾向,給對方反駁空間。

questions.prompt: 想表達「完全同意」最商務感?
options: I'm fully on board with that.
questions.explanationZh: on board 是商務「上船 / 加入」用語,fully = 完全。

questions.prompt: 想委婉反對(softest)?
options: I see your point, but have we considered an alternative?
questions.explanationZh: I see your point ≠ I agree;給對方台階,用疑問句帶反對。

questions.prompt: 提風險點不吵架的句型?
options: One concern I have is the timeline.
questions.explanationZh: One concern I have 是中性表達不同意;不會被解讀為攻擊。

questions.prompt: 想延續別人的點,顯團隊合作感?
options: Ignore that, let me tell you ...
questions.explanationZh: Building on what [Name] said = 在這基礎上,顯團隊合作而不是搶話。

questions.prompt: 「Based on the data, ...」這句的功能?
options: 立刻表明你不憑感覺,反對方要拿數據反
questions.explanationZh: Based on the data 是英文最有力的開頭之一,把對話拉到事實層次。

questions.prompt: I think maybe perhaps ... 是哪種問題?
options: 疊三層緩和語 = 聽起來沒自信
questions.explanationZh: 1 層緩和 + 明確建議 = 剛好強度;多層緩和會反效果。

questions.prompt: 想中等強度反對上司?
questions.explanationZh: respectfully disagree 是英文反對的正式禮貌版,適合給上司 / 客戶。

questions.prompt: 沒聽懂某個術語,最聰明的問法?
options: Sorry, could you clarify what you mean by EBITDA?
questions.explanationZh: Could you clarify what you mean by [X] 顯示你大致懂,只是確認某詞,比 I don't understand 顯專業。

questions.prompt: 想確認自己理解對的金句?
options: Let me see if I understand correctly — you're saying we should postpone?
questions.explanationZh: Let me see if I understand correctly 是會議專家常用,顯示你有聽 + 想對齊。

questions.prompt: 簡報開場最溫暖?
options: Today I'll walk you through our Q2 results.
questions.explanationZh: walk you through = 帶你走過,比 explain 溫暖,簡報開場高頻。

questions.prompt: 簡報想強調重點,觀眾會記筆記?
options: The key takeaway here is that customer churn dropped 15%.
questions.explanationZh: key takeaway 是簡報黃金句,觀眾聽到會記筆記。

questions.prompt: 簡報結尾 CTA,最有效?
options: The next step is launching pilot, and I'd love your support on this.
questions.explanationZh: I'd love your support 比 Please support 軟而有效;搭明確 next step。

questions.prompt: 想禮貌打斷別人?
options: Sorry to interrupt — could I add a quick thought?
questions.explanationZh: Sorry to interrupt 是模板級緩衝句。

questions.prompt: 想擋下別人的打斷,又承諾回頭(金句)?
options: Let me finish this thought, then I'll come back to you.
questions.explanationZh: 金句!既擋下又承諾不忽視對方,健康會議的核心句型。

questions.prompt: 會議跑題了想拉回來?
options: Let's circle back to the main topic.
questions.explanationZh: circle back to 是商務用語,比 back to the topic 專業。

questions.prompt: 想把事項移到下次會議?(美式商務)
options: Let's table this for next meeting.
questions.explanationZh: 美式 table = 暫緩 / 移後(英式相反!跨國會議用美式)。

questions.prompt: 想預告會議快結束?
options: In the interest of time, let's wrap up.
questions.explanationZh: In the interest of time 比 time's up 專業;wrap up = 收尾。

questions.prompt: 結尾整理共識,最自然?
options: To recap, we've agreed on the new pricing model.
questions.explanationZh: recap 比 summarize 在會議結尾更口語自然;recap 是 recapitulation 的縮寫。

questions.prompt: 「Action items: Mary will deliver by Friday.」的功能?
options: 具體到誰 / 做什麼 / 何時 的會議結尾標配
questions.explanationZh: Action items 是會議結尾標配;明確 owner + task + deadline 才不會散會後沒人做。

questions.prompt: EOD 是什麼?
questions.explanationZh: EOD = end of day;EOW = end of week。商務簡寫。

questions.prompt: 美式內部會議超口語收尾?
questions.explanationZh: call it = 就此打住,美式內部超口語;給上司用會太隨意。

questions.prompt: 想引導發言權給某人?
options: Bob, what's your take on this?
questions.explanationZh: what's your take 比 what do you think 更口語商務;直接喊名字 + take 上比較得體。
